description: The document for an id from search (code:44-7-34, ga-const:art-i-sec-i-para-i, bill:2025-2026/hb136, opinion:S26A0060, meeting:2026-02-05/house-rules): the same Markdown twin the site serves at url plus .md (frontmatter, verbatim text, any summaries under a heading that names them), with url the canonical page for citation and metadata from the frontmatter. Returns at most `max_chars` characters (default 60,000); a longer document ends with the fetch call for the next part, and metadata.next_start gives its `start`. `full` adds the optional material, or for the Code and constitutions the first 60,000-character page of the notes, whose frontmatter names the next page.
